title: The print order: final artwork deadline, fallback and spending ceiling
detail: 2 of 7 printers have replied: one cannot make Friday 6 November, one quoted but only in white, black or grey, and only if paid and given final artwork today. The brief: https://web-summit.sgit.ai/print-order/#status
recommend: Final artwork and sizes by Tuesday 3 November noon; a ceiling for Silvio; Monday 9 November delivery as the fallback
options: Artwork and sizes final by Tue 3 Nov
Fallback: black/white blanks, or Monday 9 Nov delivery, or fewer colours
A spending ceiling so Silvio can confirm without waiting
